_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve surface_pde#3: mesh.Curve(order) controls the geometry error of ds integrals on a curved surface, and Curve(1) is a no-op. Verified on NGSolve 6.2.2604, OCCGeometry(Sphere(r=1)) maxh=0.3, ne=422 (2026-08-06): Integrate(1*ds) against 4*pi gives 12.31844056 (-1.973%) with no Curve, the bitwise same value under Curve(1), then 12.56426008 / 12.56657695 / 12.56637398 / 12.56637022 for Curve(2..5). The fixture also records the mechanism: mesh.GetCurveOrder() already returns 1 on a freshly generated mesh, so Curve(1) asks for what is there. mesh.Curve(0) segfaults this NGSolve build and is deliberately not exercised.
